First batch (5 blog agents) discovered and self-resolved a shared-session-id collision (concurrent agents given the identical literal session-id string clobbered each others per-session skill-context file); subsequent batches (12 docs/kb agents) were each given a unique session-id suffix to avoid this. Two agents (document-management devguide page, how-to-load-document-cpp kb page) independently discovered the same site_planner.py cluster-mislabeling issue (PDFCPP-CLUSTER-001) and self-corrected using real api_surface.md ground truth rather than the flawed cluster file -- no published-content defect resulted. The document-management.md devguide page was deleted post-hoc as a judgment call: its content, while technically accurate, documented genuinely private include/internal/ implementation classes inappropriate for public consumer-facing developer-guide content, and was non-mandatory per the site plan.
